description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to FontAwesome icons, border radius, and icon stacking layout, used for styling purposes in the project.

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Mixin to set the icon content and include the FontAwesome font styling.

methods.name: icon-FontAwesome
methods.description: Mixin to apply FontAwesome font-family and smoothing.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: Mixin to apply border-radius with vendor prefixes.

methods.name: icon-stack
methods.description: Mixin to create a stack of icons with configurable size and layout.
